caseName: Arizona Superior Mining Co. v. Anderson
caseNameFull: Arizona Superior Mining Co. v. Anderson
attorneys: Mr. Francis M. Hartman for defendant in error in support of the motion., Mr. James P. Levin, with whom Messrs. Wm. J. Hughes and J. W. Faulkner were on the brief, for plaintiff in error in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted for the reason that no federal question was raised below. Godchaux Co. v. Estopinal, 251 U. S. 179; Wall v. Chesapeake & Ohio Ry., 256 U. S. 125.
